rawContent: How will #BlackLivesMatter be addressed in this election cycle? This Vox article is an interesting read on the issue. @JoeBiden @SenWarren, @BernieSanders #https://www.vox.com/2015/7/20/9003233/all-lives-matter-black

@PramilaJayapal @BernieSanders I don't get it. Bernie Sanders was this obscure independent Senator who voted with Democrats.  He was out front on any issues. Not Occupy Walstreet. Not on Walmart employees pay raise rallies. Not on #BlackLivesMatter He may have had a few votes but that doesn't make an advocate.

@kangaroosexy @QtrMike @chris_helps @krystalball While you're checking Biden, Sanders has been in Vermont casting votes. He hasn't been in a Black neighborhood that I know of. He didn't speak out during #BlackLivesMatter he didn't speak out during #occupywallstreet nor during Walmart wage increase protest. Save your outrage.

@kangaroosexy @QtrMike @chris_helps @krystalball I am an African by ancestry, American by designed. I am not of color. My hue is not of color. I am who I am, not what someone wants to decide me to be. When will we stop allowing others to remake us. Now we are POC. Yet, the color I saw at #BlackLivesMatter marches was we.

This #BlackHistoryMonth in 2020, we are still fighting discrimination. A young African-American male was denied the right to participate in graduation. It has never been a better time to be reminded  that #blacklivesmatter https://t.co/pZ8UGBMEjj

1963 two African American males wrongfully convicted. 1983 Lenell Geter wrongfully convicted.  1989 Central Park 5 arrested and wrongfully convicted.  #BlackHistoryMonth is about the #BlackLivesMatter ten and now.

A friend many years ago recommended "Hardball" to me. I wasn't listening to any political shows. Matthew over the years hasn't disappointed. Thank @hardball for your tenacity in political commentary. I will miss "Let's play hardball" The times are touch in the #MeToo era.

@kathleenparker I get that in the #MeToo era women want to be treated with respect and taken serious for their work and contributions. Should we fire every man who said something to a woman in his past? Sexual harassment at work vs inappropriate words- how should we evaluate the difference?

@merrill2n @kathleenparker Having been a victim of sexual harassment I know the difference between lighted hearted flirting and sexual harassment. But, hey the #metoo is ok with expanding the definition to include any behavior that offends, I guess. It should cut both ways or it isn't authentic outrage.
